limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by an agent that did not write or source-review the guide; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

Run on the shared work2 lab (openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-work2), which other DOC-030 agents used at the same time. Only records named DOC-030 contracts-a were created. The fixture Fields, Contract types and Approver groups were archived after the run; the Contracts stay as named records. Pickers therefore also listed people other DOC-030 agents created.

API sessions created prerequisites (fixture types, Fields, groups, setup Contracts, a primary PDF), played the second actor's writes, and read back saved state and refusals. Every guide step ran in the browser as the named role. See walkthrough.json.

The Business User was Lena Vogel rather than Jonas Weber: the sign-in link budget is 3 per address in 15 minutes and other agents were spending Jonas Weber's links. She signed in to the Portal with a fresh magic link from the lab Mailpit.

Type Form used: a fixture type whose Form makes Entity, Counterparties and a number Field required (so they are creation Rows) and puts a required text Field and Needed by inside a Branch on that number. The seeded types carry Entity as a record-only Row; the seeded Default type's creation Rows were Description, Counterparties, Needed by and Deal value (USD). Both were recorded.
Confirms the author's limitation: the Business Owner picker offers every active person, including Business Users (Lena Vogel was named Business Owner).
The server refusal for blank required built-in Rows names the Entity Row 'Our entity' while the create dialog labels it 'Entity'. The error still names the Row, as the guide says.
The failed upload after Create was induced with a routed 503 answer in the browser. The Legal Team Member used Continue and the Administrator used Retry failed uploads.

Product bug recorded in walkthrough.json (retype-dialog-ignores-branch): re-typing demands a required Field Row under a Branch whose condition does not hold, in the dialog and the API. The guide's re-type sentences stay true.

Not exercised: creating a Contract through an Auto-Doc Generation (technical-review.json covers it by source); a read-only view for a non-Member+ staff role, because the seed has no Contributor accounts. The Business User refusals were checked in the Portal and API. 'A link does not copy other record details' was checked for access only.
